From: Nora Wells
To: May Reed
Date written: August 07, 1844
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10341
Nora Wells asked May Reed to send the orchard inventory.

From: Nora Wells
To: May Reed
Date written: August 07, 1844
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10341

was not recorded.
